flags.message: The snapshot and linked petition identify an original writ of mandamus to enforce a Supreme Court mandate, not certiorari. The provisioned event is petition-kind without an explicit stage and carries a cert salience band. Retained the required cell and five-claim contract, interpreting any grant as relief on the mandamus petition. Cert-band base rates and cert-order route conventions are imperfect comparators; review scope and downstream scoring rather than treating this as an ordinary cert petition.
